summary: Lane County, OR lookout in the Umpqua NF: 1918 platform, 1933 19-ft L-4 tower, removed or destroyed in 1958; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 19' wooden L-4 tower (1933); a 1942 report describes a round fir timber tower with a 14x14 cab
facts.status_note: Removed in 1958 per the register; firelookout.com says destroyed. No source describes the site today.

visit.trail_note: A 1942 report gives 26 miles of road from Cottage Grove to the trailhead, then five miles by trail; no source describes access today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the 1933 tower was removed in 1958; firelookout.com says it was destroyed that year. Both agree it was gone after 1958; neither says how.
A September 1933 item planned a 10x10 lookout, but the 1942 report gives a 14x14 cab for the tower as built. The story follows the 1942 report.

notes_for_editor: Brief record matches the register (US 749, OR 158, registered 17 Nov 2010, elevation 1,510 m). Removal year disputed: removed (register) vs destroyed (firelookout.com). Height of 5.8 m is converted from the 19-ft figure. No current access or condition source found, so no access level is recorded. The register credits a 1940 photo to the Howard Verschoor collection, but no image URL was captured, so no photo is added. Staffing as_of is the removal year, since the tower could not be staffed after it was gone.
